parameters.content:
## Kettle 1: Store API
The one place that talks to the store, so every other workflow works the same in test and live.
- Reads: **abandoned_checkouts**, **orders_since**, **find_order** (number + email must both match), **inventory**, **reviews_since**.
- Writes to our own tables: **mark_contacted** (never email a checkout twice), **tag_reviews**.
Live mode reads the Shopify Admin GraphQL API (needs a **Shopify Admin token** credential: header `X-Shopify-Access-Token`); reviews come from the review app, kept in **Kettle Reviews**.
